request: Promote already-running verified receiver Stage over stale production, preserving original IP and backup for rollback

bounded_host_request.command:
bash -ec '
old=server-core-bounded-host
stage=server-core-bounded-host-stage-96d01bb
backup=server-core-bounded-host-prev-6b541d27
net=gace-internal
docker inspect "$stage" >/dev/null
! docker inspect "$backup" >/dev/null 2>&1
docker exec "$stage" python3 -c "import urllib.request; assert urllib.request.urlopen(\"http://127.0.0.1:8789/healthz\", timeout=2).status==200"
rollback() {
 if docker inspect "$backup" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if docker inspect "$old" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   docker network disconnect "$net" "$old" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
   docker rename "$old" "$stage" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
   docker network connect "$net" "$stage" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
  fi
  docker rename "$backup" "$old" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
  docker network connect --ip 172.27.0.2 --alias "$old" "$net" "$old" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
  docker start "$old" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
 fi
}
trap rollback ERR
docker stop "$old" >/dev/null
docker network disconnect "$net" "$old"
docker rename "$old" "$backup"
docker network disconnect "$net" "$stage"
docker rename "$stage" "$old"
docker network connect --ip 172.27.0.2 --alias "$old" "$net" "$old"
docker exec "$old" python3 -c "import urllib.request,socket; assert urllib.request.urlopen(\"http://127.0.0.1:8789/healthz\",timeout=3).status==200; assert socket.gethostbyname(\"server-core-bounded-host\")==\"172.27.0.2\""
trap - ERR
echo RECEIVER_STAGE_PROMOTED_AND_HEALTHY
'
